short_title: 14 versions of Claude. Who is this choice for?
linkedin_post:
Claude now lists 14 versions of itself to pick from. ChatGPT has Astra, Sol and Luna, each with a thinking dial that runs from low to max.

The obvious read is choice. My read is the opposite: the longer the menu gets, the less you actually choose.

Every model name is doing four jobs at once. Version number. Price tag. Advert. Queue ticket that sends easy questions to cheap computers.

Prices aren't the con. The cost of AI as good as the first ChatGPT fell from $20 to 7 cents per million tokens in two years. The catch is the missing meter: most apps never tell you which model answered, how hard it thought, or what it used.

For anyone building on AI, that changes the question. Stop asking which model is best. Ask what a good answer costs you, all in, and pin the exact version you run on.

My call, dated: by 30 September 2027, at least two of OpenAI, Anthropic and Google pick the model for app builders by default. 85% sure.
